name: View Modes Inventory
description: Ships a standard inventory of node view modes — impressed, featured, text, overlay and hero cards at several sizes — and, when you enable one on a bundle's display, writes both a core view display and a matching Canvas SDC card content template.
project_description: View Modes Inventory (VMI) ships a ready-made inventory of node view modes — impressed, featured, text, overlay and hero cards at several sizes plus a plain card — as install-time configuration, so a new site starts with a known display vocabulary instead of building each view mode by hand. On enable it creates 17 node view modes. When a site builder ticks one of those modes as a custom display on a content type's Manage display screen and saves, VMI auto-generates the display for that bundle: a core.entity_view_display with the media and description fields pre-placed, and a matching canvas.content_template that binds the theme's SDC card component (card, card-featured, card-impressed, card-overlay, card-text) to the node's title, media and body via Canvas dynamic-source expressions. The 5.0 major is a full re-platform onto drupal/canvas (Single Directory Components) and drops the earlier Display Suite / UI Patterns / Varbase Components stack; it is Drupal 11 only (core_version_requirement ~11.4.0). The module is sponsored and developed by Vardot.
